slides.fact: _seven seasick sailors_: the classic tongue twister for the Swedish sj-sound.

slides.title: What is the sj-sound?
slides.body: It's a breathy, rushing sound, a bit like a soft _sh_ said with rounded lips. English has nothing quite like it, and many learners find it the hardest sound in Swedish.

slides.title: The full twister
slides.sv: *Sju sjösjuka sjömän* sköttes av sju sköna sjuksköterskor.
slides.en: Seven seasick sailors were looked after by seven lovely nurses.

caption:
Sju sjösjuka sjömän: seven seasick sailors. It's the classic Swedish tongue twister for the sj-sound.

The long version keeps going: sju sjösjuka sjömän sköttes av sju sköna sjuksköterskor på skeppet Shanghai.

Can you say it three times fast?
